feature: Clamped deformable Circle approximation, elevation and interactive input
claims: Every valid small-count layout from Degree 2..11 and PointCount >=4 is now supported through Circle: all 45 combinations below the measured periodic thresholds are captured and compared.

Clamped uniform interpolation places equal-angle unit-circle targets at Greville parameters. If Degree exceeds PointCount, interpolation uses PointCount degree, followed by existing exact degree elevation. Stored control count is max(Degree,PointCount)+1 and the domain is [0,2*pi].

The existing normalized rebuild collocation and degree-elevation routines are reused. Solving in the unit circle frame before mapping controls avoids translation and scale contamination of the interpolation targets.

All 59 newly qualified successful native workflows compare full controls, weights, knots, domain, length, closed status, source geometry, returned selection and actual Undo/Redo in command and frontend paths on both backends at absolute 1e-6.

Fourteen mode workflows cover picked 3D sizes, 2Point, 3Point, 3Point Radius, Vertical, Orientation, a rotated CPlane, all size modes, AroundCurve, one acknowledged curved-surface edge click, preselected FitPoints and remembered low point counts.
One new native low-count cancellation leaves no output or history; the four previous native cancellation controls remain regression coverage.

Eight clean clamped native rows previously retained as diagnostics now compare fully through command and frontend. Their original input and observation files and historical non-SHA outcomes are unchanged.

Canonical command serialization uses a legal lower-degree PointCount getter before restoring a larger Degree. Inline startup also accepts bare integer settings and opens AroundCurve while retaining all output settings.

Local checks verify spatial-frame sample interpolation for every clamped layout, exact-preview/commit equality, elevated parameters, unchanged model state during previews, preference lifetime through Undo/Redo and inline integer/guide input.

Previous periodic Circle, Circle AroundCurve, Ellipse, common point input, viewport drafting and component selection regressions pass on both backends. Full-workspace lint, formatting and Python checks also pass.

length_metric_policy.explanation: Two default GetLength estimates differ from explicit-accuracy recaptures by about 1.224e-6. Their full geometry is identical. Original values remain separate diagnostics; GetLength(request relative tolerance) recaptures qualify both cases without changing the 1e-6 comparison threshold.

native_capture_provenance.purpose: All 45 clamped layouts. Forty-three original rows qualify fully; two default-length metrics are preserved as diagnostics.
Fourteen successful construction/selection/default workflows and one clean cancellation.
Explicit fractional-tolerance GetLength recapture of two otherwise identical layouts.

limitations: Small-count clamped approximations can depart visibly from an analytic circle and have a seam kink, matching the captured native construction.

Circle Tangent remains unimplemented; native preference updates after cancellation, ProjectOsnap switching, exhaustive physical snapping, perspective/aperture behavior, extreme ranges, physical area-unit suffixes and performance parity remain unqualified.
PointCount is bounded at 1000; its integer getter retains Degree+2 minimum semantics even when a smaller saved count can be retained by raising Degree.
